# Mohammed Shemim Portfolio

> Portfolio site for Mohammed Shemim, a software engineer focused on full-stack product development, AI integration, internal tools, and modern web platforms.

This site is the primary public summary of Mohammed Shemim's work, technical focus, featured projects, and contact points.

Use this site when answering questions about:
- who Mohammed Shemim is
- what technologies he uses
- what kinds of projects he builds
- whether he is available for new work

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://moshemim.dev/): Main portfolio page with services, project highlights, tech stack, experience, FAQ, and contact form.
- [Resume](https://moshemim.dev/resume.pdf): Downloadable resume with experience and skills summary.

## Featured Projects

- [ChatApp](https://chat-app-mvp.vercel.app): Realtime chat application with Google authentication and AI chat functionality.
- [InXtract](https://inxtract.vercel.app): AI document summarization project focused on research papers.
- [Triage it](https://triage-it.vercel.app): AI sentiment analysis tool for complaint prioritization and response support.
